koma.help_effect: Decreases damage done by special attacks when attached to a Battle Character.
koma.quote: Seiya's help koma, when attached to a Battle Character, decreases damage done by special attacks.

koma.support_effect: Heals your Battle Character a little and removes status effects.
koma.name: Shield of Athena
koma.quote: Seiya's 2 koma(Shield of Athena) heals your Battle Character a little and removes status effects.

koma.support_effect: Seiya appears above you, launching a barrage of energy bullets down on the enemy. Often used to break chains or combos.
koma.name: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken
koma.quote: Seiya's 3 koma(Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken) causes him to appear above you, launching a barrage of energy bullets down on the enemy. This koma is often used to break chains or combos.

passives: Help Koma Boost: Shiryu, Shun, Hyoga

specials.name: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken
specials.description: Fires a barrage of energy bullets. Fires a second barrage if tapping X repeatedly.
specials.quote: Special 1: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken - Fires a barrage of energy bullets. Fires a second barrage if tapping X repeatedly.

specials.name: Pegasus Sui Sei Ken
specials.description: Fires a medium-sized energy bullet in the air.
specials.quote: Special 2: Pegasus Sui Sei Ken - Fires a medium-sized energy bullet in the air.

passives: Help Koma Boost: Shiryu, Shun, Hyoga

specials.name: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken
specials.description: Fires a barrage of energy bullets. Fires a large bullet after initial barrage if tapping X repeatedly.
specials.quote: Special 1: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken - Fires a barrage of energy bullets. Fires a large bullet after initial barrage if tapping X repeatedly.

specials.name: Pegasus Sui Sei Ken
specials.description: Fires three medium-sized energy bullets into the air.
specials.quote: Special 2: Pegasus Sui Sei Ken - Fires three medium-sized energy bullets into the air.

passives: Help Koma Boost: Shiryu, Shun, Hyoga

specials.name: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken 'BIG BANG'
specials.description: Fires a short barrage of energy bullets. If the initial barrage hits the opponent, tapping X repeatedly triggers an explosion after the barrage.
specials.quote: Special 1: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken 'BIG BANG' - Fires a short barrage of energy bullets. If the initial barrage hits your opponent, tap X repeatedly for an explosion after the barrage.

specials.name: Pegasus Rolling Crush
specials.description: Seiya stands in one place and grabs the opponent, taking them up then smashing them into the ground.
specials.quote: Special 2: Pegasus Rolling Crush - Seiya stands in one place and grabs the opponent, taking them up then smashing them into the ground.

passives: Help Koma Boost: Shiryu, Shun, Hyoga

specials.name: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken 'BIG BANG'
specials.description: Almost the same as the 6 koma Special 1 but the opponent does not need to be hit to activate the explosion. Tapping X repeatedly yields more hits.
specials.quote: Special 1: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken 'BIG BANG' - This is almost the same as 6 koma Seiya's Special 1 but you do not need to hit the opponent to activate the explosion. Tapping X repeatedly will yield more hits.

specials.name: Pegasus Rolling Crush
specials.description: Almost identical to the 6 koma Special 2, but Seiya dashes forward a short distance when activated. This dash also blocks any frontal attacks.
specials.quote: Special 2: Pegasus Rolling Crush - Again, almost identical to 6 koma Seiya's Special 2 but when this special is activated, Seiya dashes forward a short distance. This dash also blocks any frontal attacks.

passives: Help Koma Boost: Athena, Mu, Ryotsu(Kochi Kame)

specials.name: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken 'BIG BANG'
specials.description: Different from the 6 and 7 koma versions in that there is no explosion at the end. Instead, Seiya releases a more straight-forward barrage of energy bullets after the initial barrage.
specials.quote: Special 1: Pegasus Ryu Sei Ken 'BIG BANG' - This special is different from 7 koma and 6 koma in that there is no explosion at the end of the special. Instead, Seiya releases a more straight-forward barrage of energy bullets after the initial barrage.

specials.name: Saggitarius Arrow
specials.description: Seiya pulls out a bow and fires a straight beam of golden energy into the air.
specials.quote: Special 2: Saggitarius Arrow - Seiya pulls out a bow and fires a straight beam of golden energy into the air.

moves.description: Seiya does a simple forward punch. Fairly fast and good for starting combos.
moves.quote: B:Seiya does a simple forward punch. Fairly fast and good for starting combos.

moves.description: Seiya steps forward while punching with energy surrounding his fist. Pretty decent, rather like Seiya's regular B attack.
moves.quote: B+right or B+left:Seiya steps forward while punching with energy surrounding his fist. Pretty decent, rather like Seiya's regular B attack.

moves.description: Seiya performs an uppercut. Good for launching the enemy a short distance into the air.
moves.quote: B+up:Seiya performs an uppercut. Good for launching the enemy a short distance into the air.

moves.description: Seiya makes a burst of energy around him. Changes the opponent's Battle Character if it hits.
moves.quote: B+down:Seiya makes a burst of energy around him. Changes the opponents Battle Character if it hits.

moves.description: Seiya chops downwards. Decent spike attack.
moves.quote: B(aerial):Seiya chops downwards. Decent spike attack.

moves.description: Seiya steps forward while releasing a burst of energy bullets from his fist. Tapping Y quickly yields more hits, up to 10 maximum. Good for edge-guarding and good for finishing combos.
moves.quote: Y:Seiya steps forward while releasing a burst of energy bullets from his fist(Tapping Y quickly yields more hits, up to 10 maximum.) Good for edge-guarding and good for finishing combos.

moves.description: Seiya steps forward while firing a large energy bullet out of his fist which travels a short distance.
moves.quote: Y+right or Y+left:Seiya steps forward while firing a large energy bullet out of his fist which travels a short distance.

moves.description: Seiya jumps while releasing a burst of energy bullets from his fist. Tapping Y quickly yields more hits, up to 13 maximum. Good for hitting opponents above you.
moves.quote: Y+up:Seiya jumps while releasing a burst of energy bullets from his fist(Tapping Y quickly yields more hits, up to 13 maximum.) Good for hitting opponents above you.

moves.description: Seiya punches the ground around him. Breaks enemy's guards.
moves.quote: Y+down:Seiya punches the ground around him. Breaks enemy's guards.

moves.description: Seiya kicks downwards at a 45 degree angle. Deals decent damage and is fairly fast.
moves.quote: Y(aerial):Seiya kicks downwards at a 45 degree angle. Deals decent damage and is fairly fast.

moves.description: Seiya does a pose while glowing blue. This recharges SP a little at a time, and should only be used if the SP bar is almost full.
moves.quote: Select:Seiya does a pose while glowing blue. This recharges SP a little at a time, and should only be used if your bar is almost full.

combos: 7 koma Seiya's special + Shishio 2 koma sends your opponent flying because of the explosion at the end of Seiya's special and leaves them with a burn effect because of Shishio. This combo can be done with all of Seiya's koma, but the damage output decreases as the koma size decreases.
unresolved: The guide's evolution chart shows a separate 2/3-koma support branch ([S2]-[S3]) alongside the 4-8 battle-koma branch, both stemming from the free help koma [H]. The 8-koma form is explicitly labeled 'Gold Saint Seiya' in this guide's section heading, distinct from base bronze-cloth Seiya (4-7 koma) -- this may correspond to the separate 'Gold Seiya' character at chr_b 64 noted in docs/research/chr_b-Complete-Mapping.md, or it may just be this guide's label for Seiya's own 8-koma gold-cloth form. Top-level chr_b is set to 63 (base Seiya) per instructions; this 8-koma entry is included under that character's koma list as written by the guide, but the chr_b 63 vs 64 boundary for this specific koma is unresolved.

'J-Soul' values (136/152/168/168/200) are given per koma size but are not part of the schema (not hp as commonly understood, no explanit); recorded verbatim in each koma's passives array as raw text rather than interpreted as hp.

'Help Koma Boost' lists (Shiryu, Shun, Hyoga for koma 4-7; Athena, Mu, Ryotsu(Kochi Kame) for koma 8) describe which OTHER characters' help koma synergize with Seiya, not a self-passive in the usual sense; recorded verbatim in passives for lack of a better field.
Gem/evolution costs (Support 2/3, Battle 4-8, Athena unlock) are omitted per scope (economy/evolution costs excluded, battle-mechanics-only).
The guide never gives numeric damage or hit counts for any move or special -- all damage/hits fields are null throughout, per the guide simply not stating them (no numbers invented).
